Jackiopsis is a monotypic genus of flowering plants in the Rubiaceae family. It was described by Colin Ernest Ridsdale in 1979. The genus contains only one species, viz. Jackiopsis ornata, which is found in Borneo, Malaysia and Sumatra. It is also the only species in the tribe Jackieae.
Knema conferta is a species of plant in the Myristicaceae family. It is found in Indonesia, Malaysia, and Singapore.
Limnophila aromatica (synonym: Limnophila chinensis var. aromatica; also called rice paddy herb) is a tropical flowering plant in the plantain family, Plantaginaceae.
Lithocarpus bennettii is a tree in the beech family Fagaceae. It is named for the English botanist John Joseph Bennett.
Lithocarpus blumeanus is a tree in the beech family Fagaceae. It is named for the German-Dutch botanist Carl Ludwig Blume.
Lithocarpus conocarpus is a tree in the beech family Fagaceae. The specific epithet conocarpus is from the Greek meaning "cone fruit", referring to the acorn shape.
Lithocarpus ewyckii is a tree in the beech family Fagaceae. It is named for D.J. van Ewijck van Oostbroek en De Built of the Dutch Colonial Service.

Litsea garciae, also known as engkala, engkalak, kangkala, pangalaban and Borneo avocado, is a flowering plant belonging to the family Lauraceae and genus Litsea. It is native to Taiwan, the Philippines, Borneo, the Malay Peninsula, Sumatra, Java, and Sulawesi.

images.credit: Smithsonian Institution, National Museum of Natural History, Department of Botan

species.name: Cempaka Gunung
species.summary: Magnolia liliifera, commonly known as egg magnolia, is a flowering tree native to the Indomalayan realm. It bears white to cream-colored flowers on terminal stems. The leaves are elliptical and get as large as 25 cm (10 in) long and 8 cm (3 in) wide. The tree ranges in height from 3.5 to 18.5 m (12 to 60 ft) in situ.
Maranthes corymbosa is a tree in the family Chrysobalanaceae. The specific epithet corymbosa is from the Greek meaning "cluster", referring to the clustered inflorescences.
Melicope glabra is a tree in the citrus family Rutaceae. The specific epithet glabra is from the Latin meaning "hairless".
Euodia lunuankenda is a species of plant in the family Rutaceae. It is native to tropical Asia.

Musa gracilis is a species of wild banana (genus Musa), native to Peninsular Malaysia. It is placed in section Callimusa (now including the former section Australimusa), having a diploid chromosome number of 2n = 20. It grows to less than 2 m (7 ft) tall.

species.name: Kantong semar tutup kunci
species.summary: [[Kategori:Semua regnum plantae

species.name: Kantong semar kerah lebar
species.summary: Nepenthes veitchii adalah tanaman varietas dataran tinggi. Tapi dapat juga hidup di dataran rendah tergantung pada tanaman jenis tanaman. Tanaman ini dikenal karena peristomanya yang sangat menyala dan dapat berwarna emas atau bergaris merah.

Jukut siraru (Ophioglossum reticulatum L.) adalah jenis tumbuhan paku sejati berukuran kecil yang dapat ditemukan di tempat-tempat terang tetapi basah, seperti tepi lapangan rumput, lahan-lahan terbuka terbengkalai atau berbatu yang lembap, ladang/huma, pematang sawah, tepi sungai, atau di bawah kebun-kebun karet.

images.credit: Mark Hyde, Bart Wursten and Petra Ballings

species.summary: Parishia insignis is a flowering plant in the family Anacardiaceae. It is native to Southeast Asia.
Pentaspadon motleyi is a species of plant in the Anacardiaceae family. It is found in Indonesia, Malaysia, Papua New Guinea, and the Solomon Islands. It is threatened by habitat loss.
Plagiostachys albiflora is a monocotyledonous plant species. It is part of the genus Plagiostachys and the family Zingiberaceae.

species.name: Daun Putat
species.summary: Putat (Lat.:Planchonia valida B1.) adalah tumbuhan liar yang hidup dihutan primer di Malaysia dan Indonesia. Putat, dalam ilmu tumbuh-tumbuhan, dikenal dengan nama Planchonia valida (Bi.) BL dan termasuk dalam suku Lecythidaceae.

Quercus argentata atau pasang mempening adalah spesies tropis pohon pasang yang selalu hijau dalam keluarga beech Fagaceae . Tidak ada subspesies yang diketahui. Tumbuhan ini ditempatkan dalam subgenus Cerris, bagian Cyclobalanopsis . Nama ilmiahnya diambil dari rambut halus keperakan di permukaan bawah daunnya.
Quercus gemelliflora is a tree species in the beech family Fagaceae. there are no known subspecies. It is placed in subgenus Cerris, section Cyclobalanopsis (the ring-cupped oaks).

Rauvolfia verticillata, the common devil pepper, grows as a shrub up to 5 metres (20 ft) tall. The bark is yellowish black or brown. Inflorescences bear up to 35 or more flowers. The flowers feature a white or pinkish corolla. Fruits are whitish purple when ripe, ovoid, up to 1.4 cm (1 in) long.
Santiria apiculata is a species of plant in the Burseraceae family. It is found in Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, and Singapore.
Santiria laevigata is a species of plant in the Burseraceae family. It is found in Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, and Singapore.

Sarcotheca diversifolia, also known as pupoi or belimbing bulat in Malay and more locally as tabarus, piang or belimbing hutan, is a species of flowering plant, a fruit tree in the wood sorrel family, that is native to Southeast Asia.
Sarcotheca rubrinervis is a tree in the family Oxalidaceae. The specific epithet rubrinervis means 'red nerve', referring to the leaf veins.

Rija-rija (Scleria sumatrensis), atau juga disebut kerisan, adalah sejenis rumput yang termasuk ke dalam suku teki-tekian. Gulma di perkebunan dan tanah paya ini menyebar di Asia tropis mulai dari India hingga Formosa, melalui Malesia hingga ke Queensland, Australia.

species.name: Kulim
species.summary: Kulim, kayu bawang, atau bawang hutan (Scorodocarpus borneensis) adalah sejenis pohon kayu, anggota satu-satunya dari genus Scorodocarpus, famili Olacaceae. Dinamai demikian, karena pepagan dan kayunya mengeluarkan bau bawang yang kuat.
Sterculia rubiginosa is a plant species, belonging to the genus Sterculia and the family Malvaceae (previously the Sterculiaceae, now relegated to a subfamily).

Strobocalyx arborea, yang sebelumnya dikenal luas dengan sinonim Vernonia arborea, adalah spesies pohon hutan hujan tingkat menengah dalam keluarga bunga matahari atau Asteraceae (suku kenikir-kenikiran), yang ditemukan dari Ghats Barat di India dan Sri Lanka, ke arah timur hingga Hindia Timur dan Nugini.
Strombosia ceylanica is a tree in the family Olacaceae. The specific epithet ceylanica is from the Latin meaning "of Ceylon".
Symplocos fasciculata is a tree in the family Symplocaceae, native to tropical Asia. The specific epithet fasciculata means 'bundled' and refers to the inflorescence.

images.credit: Smithsonian Institution, National Museum of Natural History, Department of Botan

species.summary: Rombusa (Tabernaemontana corymbosa) adalah spesies bunga dari keluarga apocynaceae yang ditemukan di Brunei, China, Indonesia, Laos, Malaysia, Myanmar, Singapura, Thailand, dan Vietnam.

Xanthophyllum ecarinatum is a tree in the family Polygalaceae. The specific epithet ecarinatum is from the Latin meaning "not keeled", referring to the fact that the petals do not form the shape of a boat (or carina).

species.name: Sukun
species.summary: Sukun, kulur, ketimbul atau timbul (Artocarpus altilis) adalah nama sejenis pohon yang berbuah. Buah sukun tidak berbiji dan memiliki bagian yang empuk, yang mirip roti setelah dimasak atau digoreng. Karena itu, orang-orang Eropa mengenalnya sebagai "buah roti" (Ingg.: breadfruit; Bld.: broodvrucht, dll.).

species.name: Mangga
species.summary: Mangga atau mempelam adalah nama sejenis buah, demikian pula nama pohonnya. Mangga termasuk ke dalam marga Mangifera, yang terdiri dari 35-40 anggota dan suku Anacardiaceae. Nama ilmiahnya adalah Mangifera indica. Nama ini kira-kira mengandung arti: “(pohon) yang berbuah mangga, berasal dari India”.

species.name: Belimbing
species.summary: Averrhoa carambola is a species of tree in the family Oxalidaceae; it has a number of common names, including carambola and starfruit.

species.name: Kecombrang
species.summary: Kecombrang, kantan, atau honje adalah sejenis tumbuhan rempah dan merupakan tumbuhan tahunan berbentuk terna yang bunga, buah, serta bijinya dimanfaatkan sebagai bahan sayuran.

species.name: Lengkeng
species.summary: Lengkeng (juga disebut kelengkeng, matakucing, longan, Dimocarpus longan, suku lerak-lerakan atau Sapindaceae) adalah tanaman buah-buahan yang berasal dari daratan Asia Tenggara.

species.name: Manggis
species.summary: Manggis (Garcinia mangostana L.) adalah sejenis pohon hijau abadi dari daerah tropika yang diyakini berasal dari Semenanjung Malaya dan menyebar ke Kepulauan Nusantara. Tumbuh hingga mencapai ketinggian antara 7 hingga 25 meter.

species.name: Lengkuas
species.summary: Lengkuas, laos atau kelawas (bahasa Karo) (Alpinia galanga) merupakan jenis tumbuhan umbi-umbian yang bisa hidup di daerah dataran tinggi maupun dataran rendah. Lengkuas adalah salah satu jenis rempah-rempah yang banyak ditanam di Asia, seperti India, Arab, Cina, Sri Lanka, dan Indonesia.
Barclaya motleyi is a species of perennial aquatic plant native to the region spanning from Thailand to Western Malesia, and New Guinea.

Coscinium fenestratum, or yellow vine as it is sometimes referred to in English, is a flowering woody climber, native to South Asia and Mainland Southeast Asia. It is rare and critically endangered in many of its habitats.
Sandoricum beccarianum is a tree in the family Meliaceae. It is named for the Italian botanist Odoardo Beccari.

species.name: Kelapa
species.summary: Kelapa (Cocos nucifera) adalah anggota tunggal dalam marga Cocos dari suku aren-arenan atau Arecaceae. Arti kata kelapa (atau coconut, dalam bahasa Inggris) dapat merujuk pada keseluruhan pohon kelapa, biji, atau buah, yang secara botani adalah pohon berbuah, bukan pohon kacang-kacangan.

species.name: Tapak Dara
species.summary: Tapak dara adalah perdu tahunan yang berasal dari Madagaskar, namun telah menyebar ke berbagai daerah tropika lainnya. Nama ilmiahnya Catharanthus roseus (L.) Don.

species.name: bandotan
species.summary: Bandotan (Ageratum conyzoides) adalah sejenis gulma pertanian anggota suku Asteraceae. Terna semusim ini berasal dari Amerika tropis, khususnya Brasil, akan tetapi telah lama masuk dan meliar di wilayah Nusantara.

species.name: Sawi Langit
species.summary: Sawi langit (nama botani Cyanthillium cinereum; dulu diklasifikasi sebagai Vernonia cinerea) adalah gulma tahunan dari famili Asteraceae.

species.name: Nangka
species.summary: Nangka (Artocarpus heterophyllus) adalah spesies pohon dalam keluarga ara, mulberi, dan sukun (Moraceae). Nangka adalah buah pohon terbesar, mencapai berat hingga 55 kg (120 pon), panjang 90 cm (35 inci), dan diameter 50 cm (20 inci).

species.name: Rimbang
species.summary: Takokak (Solanum torvum) atau terung pipit adalah tumbuhan dari suku terung-terungan (Solanaceae) yang buah dan bijinya dipakai sebagai sayuran atau bumbu. Nama dalam perdagangan internasional tidak baku, beberapa di antaranya adalah turkey berry ("buni turki") atau mini-eggplant ("terung mini").

species.name: Tembelekan
species.summary: Tahi ayam, sailara atau tembelekan (Lantana camara) adalah jenis tumbuhan berbunga dari famili Verbenaceae yang berasal dari wilayah tropis di Amerika Tengah dan Selatan . Tanaman ini tumbuh di daerah dengan ketinggian 1.700 m dpl dan memiliki banyak percabangan dengan tinggi antara 0,5-4 meter.

species.name: Kumis Kucing
species.summary: Orthosiphon aristatus atau dikenal dengan nama kumis kucing termasuk tanaman dari famili Lamiaceae/Labiatae. Tanaman ini merupakan salah satu tanaman obat asli Indonesia yang mempunyai manfaat dan kegunaan yang cukup banyak dalam menanggulangi berbagai penyakit.

Impatiens platypetala juga dikenal sebagai bunga pancur atau bunga sapa adalah spesies tumbuhan yang tergolong ke dalam famili Balsaminaceae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Ericales. Spesies Impatiens platypetala sendiri merupakan bagian dari genus Impatiens.

species.name: Senduduk
species.summary: Senduduk (Melastoma malabathricum) adalah tumbuhan semak (shrub) dan termasuk ke dalam keluarga Melastomataceae. Tumbuhan ini mempunyai bunga berwarna ungu cerah dengan batang kemerahan yang berbulu, biasanya tumbuh di padang rumput terbuka atau hutan.
Kencana ungu (Ruellia simplex) adalah salah satu tanaman berbunga ungu, merah jambu atau biru (ada juga yang berwarna putih) yang berasal dari keluarga Acanthaceae.

species.name: Eceng Gondok
species.summary: Eichhornia crassipes, commonly known as common water hyacinth, is an aquatic plant native to the Amazon basin, and is often a highly problematic invasive species outside its native range.

Paku sarang burung (Asplenium nidus, syn.: A. ficifolium Goldm., Thamnopteris nidus (L.) C. Presl., Neottopteris rigida Feé) merupakan jenis tumbuhan paku populer sebagai tanaman hias halaman. Orang Sunda menyebutnya kadaka, sementara dalam bahasa Jawa dikenal dengan kedakah.

species.name: Permot
species.summary: Rambusa, markisa mini atau ermot (Passiflora foetida) adalah nama sejenis buah kecil, yang ketika masak tertutup oleh perbesaran kelopak bunga.

species.name: Kacang Meongan
species.summary: Aeschynomene americana is a species of flowering plant in the family Fabaceae (legume) known by many common names, including shyleaf, forage aeschynomene, American joint vetch (United States and Australia), thornless mimosa (Sri Lanka), bastard sensitive plant (Jamaica), pega pega, pega ropa, antejuela, ronte, cujicill…

species.name: Paku Perak
species.summary: Paku perak (Pityrogramma calomelanos) adalah spesies tumbuhan paku yang termasuk ke dalam keluarga Pteridaceae. Tumbuhan ini mempunyai rimpang pendek, berdiameter sekitar 8 mm, biasanya tumbuh di bebatuan dan pinggir jalan, baik di hutan maupun di lingkungan yang lebih terbuka.

species.name: Anggrek Bambu
species.summary: Arundina graminifolia, the bamboo orchid, is a species of orchid and the sole accepted species of the genus Arundina. This tropical Asiatic genus extends from India, Sri Lanka, Nepal, Thailand, Vietnam, the Ryukyu Islands, Malaysia, Singapore, China to Indonesia, the Philippines and New Guinea.

species.name: Calincing
species.summary: Daun asam kecil (Oxalis corniculata) atau biasa disebut juga calincing (Sd), lela (Ac), daun asam kecil, semanggen (Jw), semanggi (Pb), cembicenan (Md), dan mala-mala (Tn) adalah tumbuhan obat liar yang dapat tumbuh di tempat terbuka maupun agak terlidung seperti di tepi jalan maupun lapangan rumput.

species.name: Beruwas laut
species.summary: Scaevola taccada, also known as beach cabbage, sea lettuce, beach naupaka, naupaka kahakai (Hawaiian), magoo (Divehi), merambong (Malay), bapaceda or papatjeda (Moluccan Islands), ngahu (Tongan) is a flowering plant in the family Goodeniaceae found in coastal locations in the tropical areas of the Indo-Pacific.

images.credit: Smithsonian Institution, National Museum of Natural History, Department of Botan

species.name: Keladi
species.summary: Caladium bicolor adalah spesies keladi (genus Caladium) yang berasal dari Amerika Latin. Ia ditanam sebagai tanaman dalam ruangan karena daunnya yang besar, berbentuk hati atau tombak dengan bercak hijau, putih, merah muda, dan merah yang mencolok. Ratusan kultivar tersedia.

species.name: Pacar Air
species.summary: Pacar air (bahasa Latin: Impatiens balsamina L.) adalah tanaman yang berasal dari Asia Selatan dan Asia Tenggara namun telah diperkenalkan ke Amerika pada abad ke-19. Tanaman ini adalah tanaman tahunan atau dua tahunan dan memiliki bunga yang berwarna putih, merah, ungu, atau merah jambu.

species.name: Pakis Payung
species.summary: Dipteris conjugata is a species of fern. It has a rhizome, and 2-3 tall stems with mid green or dark green fronds, which have several divisions to toothed lobes. It is grows in clearings, mountain ridges and in forest margins, from tropical and temperate Asia, Australia and some islands in the Pacific Ocean.

images.credit: Museum of New Zealand Te Papa Tongarewa

species.name: Jawer Kotok
species.summary: Plectranthus scutellarioides, commonly known as coleus, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae (the mint or deadnettle family), native to southeast Asia through to Australia.

species.name: Gadung Tikus
species.summary: Tacca palmata adalah spesies tumbuhan dari famili Dioscoreaceae yang tumbuh di bioma beriklim tropis basah yang tersebar mulai dari Indo-China hingga kawasan Malesia dan Kepulauan Caroline (Palau). Pada tahun 1827, Carl Ludwig Blume memperkenalkan nama ilmiah untuk spesies ini.

species.name: Tempuh Wiyang
species.summary: Emilia sonchifolia, also known as lilac tasselflower or cupid's shaving brush is tropical flowering species of tasselflower and in the sunflower family.

species.name: Alamanda
species.summary: Allamanda cathartica adalah tanaman hias yang umum disebut sebagai bunga alamanda dan juga sering disebut sebagai bunga terompet emas, bunga lonceng kuning, atau bunga buttercup.

Blechnopsis orientalis is a species of fern. Found growing naturally in many parts of the world, such as India, China, South-east Asia to northern Australia. The often published name Blechnum orientale is now considered by many authorities as a synonym of Blechnopsis orientalis.

species.name: Ara Bulu
species.summary: Ficus villosa, known as the shaggy-leaf fig or villous fig, is a species of Ficus native to South East Asia.

Palhinhaea cernua adalah sejenis tumbuhan anggota suku Lycopodiaceae. Dalam literatur dikenal sebagai paku kawat, tetapi penyebutan "paku" berdasarkan klasifikasi modern sudah tidak tepat karena berdasarkan filogeni ia lebih tepat disebut sebagai "sepupu' dari tumbuhan paku dan tumbuhan berbiji bersama-sama.
Lembayung malabar, basella rubra, bayam sailan, gandola atau gendola (Basella alba) adalah tumbuhan melilit, memiliki bunga, termasuk ke dalam genus Basella.

species.name: Patikan Cina
species.summary: Euphorbia thymifolia, commonly known as Red caustic-creeper, is a prostrate annual herb of the family Euphorbiaceae. Native to tropical and subtropical America, it grows in seasonally dry tropical biomes and produces milky sap.

species.name: Jali
species.summary: Jali, enjelai atau jelai (Coix lacryma-jobi) adalah sejenis tumbuhan biji-bijian (serealia) tropika dari suku padi-padian atau Poaceae. Asalnya adalah Asia Timur dan Malaya namun sekarang telah tersebar ke berbagai penjuru dunia.

species.name: Lemidi
species.summary: Lemidi, lemiding, atau ramiding (Stenochlaena palustris) adalah sejenis paku-pakuan anggota suku Blechnaceae. Pucuk dan daun muda pakis ini biasa dijadikan sayuran di pelbagai wilayah sebarannya.

species.name: Sirih keraton
species.summary: Cissus discolor or the Rex Begonia Vine is a species of Cissus found in Southeast Asia in China, India, Vietnam, Indonesia, and Thailand at elevations of 600–2000 meters

Phymatosorus scolopendria commonly called monarch fern, musk fern, maile-scented fern, lauaʻe or wart fern is a species of fern within the Polypodiaceae family. This fern grows in the wild in the Western Pacific rim from Australia to New Caledonia to Fiji and throughout the South Pacific to French Polynesia.

species.name: Jabon
species.summary: Jabon adalah sebuah pohon yang tumbuh di wilayah Asia. Pohon ini terdapat di wilayah Asia Selatan hingga Papua Nugini. Di Indonesia, pohon ini juga dikenal sebagai jabun, kelampayan, empayang, atau worotua.

species.name: Aseman
species.summary: Polygonum chinense, commonly known as creeping smartweed or Chinese knotweed, is a plant species from the family Polygonaceae. It is widespread across China, Japan, the Indian Subcontinent, Indonesia, Malaysia, and Vietnam.

Dillenia suffruticosa (simpoh ayer) is a species of Dillenia found in tropical South East Asia in secondary forest and swampy ground. It is a large, evergreen shrub to 6 metres high. It flowers continuously with yellow flowers 10 to 12 cm wide.

Melanthera biflora, also known as sea daisy, beach daisy and sea ox-eye, (Hindi: Bhringaraaja; Malay: Serunai laut, Pokok serunai; Fijian: Kovekove, Sekava; Maldivian: Mirihi; Samoan: Ateate; Thai: เบญจมาศน้ำเค็ม or ผักคราดทะเล; Tongan: Ate), is a species of flowering plant in the aster family.

Nggalat (Rubus moluccanus), adalah spesies tumbuhan dari famili rosaceae. Tumbuhan ini sering dijumpai hidup di pegunungan pada ketinggian lebih dari 1.000 mdpl. Tumbuhan ini menghasilkan buah agregat berwarna merah yang dapat dimakan. Tumbuhan ini kadang dijumpai hidup bersama arbei gunung

Solanum lasiocarpum, otherwise known as Indian nightshade, is a plant that produces edible fruit. Its flowers are white and its fruits are pale yellow. S. lasiocarpum is native to temperate Asia, tropical Asia and the pacific.

species.name: Sambiloto
species.summary: Andrographis paniculata is an annual herbaceous plant in the family Acanthaceae, native to India and Sri Lanka.
Piper macropiper is a species of plant in the pepper family Piperaceae, native to southeast Asia, Australia and the western Pacific. It was first described in 1800.

Rubus rosifolius, (sometimes spelled Rubus rosaefolius), also known as roseleaf bramble, Mauritius raspberry, thimbleberry Vanuatu raspberry and bramble of the Cape is a prickly subshrub native to rainforest and tall open forest of the Himalayas, East Asia, and eastern Australia.

Bunga madia (Thunbergia grandiflora) adalah tanaman merambat hijau menahun dari famili Acanthaceae. Tumbuhan ini adalah tumbuhan asli China, India, Nepal, Indochina, dan Burma, serta dinaturalisasi secara luas di berbagai tempat lain.

Vigna trilobata, the three-lobe-leaf cowpea or jungle mat bean, is a regenerating annual (though occasionally perennial) herb found in India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Burma, Afghanistan and the Malay archipelago.

Hyptis capitata, also known as false ironwort or knobweed, is a species of erect annual shrubs, of the plant family Lamiaceae. It is native to Florida, Mexico, Central America, the West Indies, and South America but naturalized in Australia, Southeast Asia, and some tropical islands.

Histiopteris incisa, the bat's wing fern, water fern or fern mata, is a common plant found in Australia, New Zealand and other islands in the south Pacific region. Usually found in moist areas, where it may form large colonies.

Nephrolepis biserrata (giant swordfern, 长叶肾蕨) is a tropical fern, endemic to Florida, Mexico, the West Indies, Central America, South America, Africa, and southeast Asia. Its stipes are grayish brown and 10–50 cm × about 4 mm in size, with brownish-green, papery lamina that are 14–30 cm wide × 0.7–2 m in length.

Setaria palmifolia is a species of grass known by the common names palmgrass, highland pitpit, hailans pitpit, short pitpit, broadleaved bristlegrass, and knotroot. In Spanish it is called pasto de palma and in Samoan vao 'ofe 'ofe. It is native to temperate and tropical Asia.
Pyrrosia longifolia adalah spesies tumbuhan paku dari genus Pyrrosia yang tumbuh di Asia Tenggara, wilayah Pasifik, dan Australia..

Crotalaria pallida (syn. Crotalaria mucronata Desc, Crotalaria striata DC, Crotalaria falcata VAHL ex DC, Crotalaria brownei DC.,Crotalaria fertilis Delile,Crotalaria hookeri Arn.,Crotalaria pisiformis Guill. Perr.,Crotalaria siamica F.N.Williams,Crotalaria striata var.

Calanthe triplicata commonly known as the common Christmas orchid is a plant in the orchid family and is native to Oceania, Asia, and the islands of eastern Africa. It is a terrestrial orchid that grows in clumps with crowded pseudobulbs, dark green corrugated leaves and up to forty white flowers.

species.name: Jelantir
species.summary: Conyza sumatrensis is an annual herb probably native to South America, but widely naturalised in tropical and subtropical regions, and regarded as an invasive weed in many places. In the British Isles it is known as Guernsey fleabane.

Hoya lacunosa is a species of plant in the genus Hoya native to Southeast Asia. Its native range is Thailand through Borneo, Java, Sumatra, and the Philippines, and it is introduced in other countries as well. Like most Hoya, it is an epiphytic vining climber.

Scindapsus pictus (satin pothos, silver vine) is a species of flowering plant in the arum family Araceae, native to Bangladesh, Thailand, Peninsular Malaysia, Borneo, Java, Sumatra, Sulawesi, and the Philippines.

species.name: Galing-Galing
species.summary: Causonis trifolia commonly known as bush Grape, fox-grape, three-leaved wild vine or threeleaf cayratia is a species of liana plant native to Australia and Asia. It has black-colored berries, and its leaves contain several flavonoids, such as cyanidin and delphinidin.
Heliconia psittacorum (Heliconia psittacorum webus) adalah spesies tanaman hias berbunga yang berasal dari Karibia dan Amerika Selatan.
Centratherum punctatum, also known by its common name Brazilian bachelor's button is a species of flowering plant from the genus Centratherum.
Hydrangea febrifuga is a flowering plant in the family Hydrangeaceae. It is a subshrub or shrub native to central and southern China, Indochina, Malesia, and New Guinea.

Rumput bambu (Pogonatherum crinitum) adalah sejenis tumbuhan obat yang masih berkerabat secara famili dengan rumput bambu (genus Lophatherum). Tumbuhan ini bermanfaat sebagai peluruh air seni dan obat demam untuk anak-anak.

Asplenium tenerum is a species of fern in the family Aspleniaceae. It is a perennial lithophyte or epiphyte native to tropical Asia, Korea, Queensland, the tropical Pacific Islands, and the Seychelles.

species.name: Daun Kepala Tupai
species.summary: Daun kepala tupai (Drynaria quercifolia (L.) J.Sm.) adalah sejenis paku-pakuan epifit anggota suku Polypodiaceae. Tumbuhan ini umum dijumpai di dataran rendah, menempel di batang pohon hingga kadang-kadang menutupi hampir seluruh permukaannya. Rimpangnya relatif tebal, tertutupi rambut berwarna coklat.

species.name: Salam
species.summary: Salam (Syzygium polyanthum) adalah nama pohon penghasil daun rempah yang digunakan dalam masakan Nusantara. Dalam bahasa Inggris dikenal sebagai Indonesian bay-leaf atau Indonesian laurel, sedangkan nama ilmiahnya adalah Syzygium polyanthum.
Piper lanatum, commonly known in Australia as peppervine, is a species of plants in the pepper family Piperaceae found from India through Southeast Asia to Queensland, Australia.

species.name: Bakung
species.summary: Crinum asiaticum (poison bulb, giant crinum lily, grand crinum lily, spider lily) is a plant species widely planted in many warmer regions as an ornamental. It is a bulb-forming perennial producing an umbel of large, showy flowers that are prized by gardeners.
Nertera granadensis, also known as coral bead plant, pin-cushion plant, coral moss, or English baby tears, is a ground cover with orange berries, of the genus Nertera.
Flagellaria indica adalah tumbuhan pemanjat yang ditemukan di banyak wilayah tropis dan subtropis di Dunia Lama, meliputi India, Bangladesh, Asia Tenggara, Polinesia, dan Australia.

Odontosoria chinensis is a fern in the family Lindsaeaceae. Commonly called lace fern (Hawaiian: pala'ā, palae, or palapala'ā), it is native from India to Hawai'i, and south to Sumatra, Borneo and the Philippines, as well as other parts of the tropics and sub-tropics.

Suji, suji hijau atau Pleomele angustifolia (Dracaena angustifolia) adalah tumbuhan perdu tahunan yang daunnya dapat dimanfaatkan sebagai pewarna hijau alami untuk makanan. Daun suji memberi warna hijau yang lebih pekat daripada daun pandan wangi, yang juga merupakan sumber warna hijau, tetapi aromanya kurang kuat.

Bulbophyllum lobbii adalah spesies tumbuhan yang tergolong ke dalam famili Orchidaceae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Asparagales. Spesies Bulbophyllum lobbii sendiri merupakan bagian dari genus Bulbophyllum. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan oleh Lindl. 1847.
Microsorum punctatum adalah tumbuhan paku yang biasa digunakan sebagai tanaman hias. Tumbuhan ini termasuk ke dalam suku Polypodiaceae.

species.name: Rumput Merak
species.summary: Rumput merak, merakan atau memerakan (Themeda arguens) adalah sejenis rumput yang hidup terutama di daerah tropis, anggota suku Poaceae. Rumput ini menyebar luas di Asia, Australasia, Pasifik, dan Amerika Selatan. Dinamakan rumput merak-merakan karena bentuk bulirnya yang mekar seperti ekor merak saat mengembang.

species.name: Tuba Laut
species.summary: Derris trifoliata is a plant species in the genus Derris.

Dianella nemorosa Lamk. adalah tumbuhan ternak, merumpun, dengan tinggi mencapai 1-1,5 meter. Akarnya merupakan akar serabut, berwarna coklat hingga kehitaman. Jika umurnya relatif dewasa biasanya akar membentuk umbi dan dapat membuat tunas baru.

Haplopteris elongata, commonly known as the tape fern, is a species of epiphytic fern. In eastern Australia, it grows in rainforests from the Watagan Hills in the south, to tropical Queensland in the north.

species.name: Tunjuk Langit
species.summary: Jajalakan adalah sejenis tumbuhan paku yang merupakan penghuni asli Asia dan Australia tropik dan dipergunakan sebagai tumbuhan obat.
Amydrium medium is a flowering plant in genus Amydrium of the arum family, Araceae.
Drynaria heracleum is one of the basket ferns in the family Polypodiaceae, native to the East Indies and Malay Peninsula. Its common name is paku suloh.

species.name: Bunga Kenop
species.summary: Bunga kenop (Gomphrena globosa) adalah spesies tumbuhan berbunga dari genus Gomphrena; tanaman ini merupakan terna semusim yang ditanam di halaman belakang ataupun pekarangan sebagai tanaman hias.
Platycerium coronarium is an epiphytic species of staghorn fern in the genus Platycerium. It is found in maritime Southeast Asia and Indochina. and throughout the East Indies.
Calanthe pulchra is a species of orchid.

Phrynium pubinerve is the type species of the plant genus Phrynium, in the family Marantaceae. It is widespread throughout Asia, with records from India, China, and Indo-China through to New Guinea; no subspecies are listed in the Catalogue of Life.

species.name: Duku
species.summary: Duku atau Lansium domesticum (kerap kali diidentifikasi dengan salah sebagai Lansium parasiticum) adalah jenis buah-buahan dari anggota suku Meliaceae. Tanaman yang berasal dari Asia Tenggara sebelah barat ini memiliki kemiripan dengan buah langsat, kokosan, pisitan, celoring dan lain-lain dengan berbagai variasinya.

Tepurang atau pupia (Momordica cochinchinensis) adalah sejenis tumbuhan buah anggota suku labu-labuan (Cucurbitaceae) yang berasal dari Asia Tenggara. Tumbuhan ini masih berkerabat dengan peria. Nama lainnya adalah pakurebu (Sulawesi), teruah atau torobuk. Di Vietnam ia dikenal sebagai gấc.

Ophioderma pendulum terkadang dikenal sebagai old-world adder's-tongue. Di Malaysia, tumbuhan ini dikenal sebagai daun rambu. Tumbuhan ini merupakan sejenis paku-pakuan dalam keluarga Ophioglossaceae, dan merupakan spesies tipe dari genus Ophioderma.

Bulbophyllum vaginatum adalah spesies tumbuhan yang tergolong ke dalam famili Orchidaceae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Asparagales. Spesies Bulbophyllum vaginatum sendiri merupakan bagian dari genus Bulbophyllum. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan oleh (Lindl.) Rchb.f.

Humata repens (sinonim: Adiantum repens) adalah tumbuhan paku/pakis epifit (fern) dan termasuk ke dalam keluarga Davalliaceae. Tanaman ini epilitik pada variasi bebatuan, terkadang terestrial, di tempat yang sangat basah sampai kering di area permukaan laut hingga 3400 m.

species.name: Gandarusa
species.summary: Gandarusa, daun rusa, atau kisi-kisi (Justicia gendarussa Burm.f.) merupakan semak tropis yang biasa dijumpai di pekarangan rumah, baik sendiri atau sebagai pagar hidup. Tumbuhan ini mudah tumbuh dan dapat diperbanyak dengan stek.

Bulbophyllum gibbosum adalah spesies tumbuhan yang tergolong ke dalam famili Orchidaceae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Asparagales. Spesies Bulbophyllum gibbosum sendiri merupakan bagian dari genus Bulbophyllum. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan oleh (Blume) Lindl. 1830.

Cayratia mollissima is an evergreen species of climber plant found in Indochina, Malaysia and the Philippines. It has 3-foliate leaves with small bluish green flowers and produces pinkish white berries, and usually grows at forest margins.

Cyperus javanicus adalah spesies tumbuhan yang tergolong ke dalam famili Cyperaceae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Poales. Spesies Cyperus javanicus sendiri merupakan bagian dari genus Cyperus. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan oleh Houtt..

species.name: Bambu Betung
species.summary: Bambu betung (Dendrocalamus asper) adalah salah satu jenis bambu yang memiliki ukuran lingkar batang yang besar dan termasuk ke dalam suku rumput-rumputan.
Lecanopteris sinuosa is a fern that belongs to the unique fern genus Lecanopteris. This epiphytic plant has a mutualistic relationship with stingless shelter ants, which makes it a myrmecophyte.

Hoya multiflora is a species of tropical plants in the family Apocynaceae. It is found in Indonesia (Sulawesi, formerly known as Celebes). It is an evergreen perennial plant with a maximum height of 50 centimeters. This plant can produce nectar.

Huperzia phlegmaria (sinonim Phlegmariurus phlegmaria, Lycopodium phlegmaria), awam dikenal sebagai kumpai rantai, adalah tumbuhan epifit asli hutan hujan di Madagaskar, beberapa pulau di Samudra Hindia, Asia, Australasia, dan banyak Kepulauan Pasifik.

species.name: Marasi
species.summary: Curculigo latifolia, also known as tambaka, lamba and lemba babi, is a species of flowering plant, a stemless perennial herb in the Hypoxidaceae family, that is native to Southeast Asia and produces edible fruits.
Davallia divaricata is a fern in the genus Davallia of the family Davalliaceae.

Simbar layangan (Jawa) atau langlayangan (Sunda), nama ilmiah Drynaria sparsisora (Desv.) T. Moore, adalah sejenis tumbuhan paku epifit yang biasa dijumpai di hutan pegunungan Asia Tenggara sampai Australia dan Papua.
Lobelia angulata, previously known as Pratia angulata, and commonly known as pānakenake, or Lawn Lobelia is a small scrambling herbaceous plant native to New Zealand.

Microlepia strigosa, known as hay-scented fern, lace fern, rigid lace fern and palapalai in Hawaiian, is a fern indigenous to the Hawaiian islands and is also native to other parts of the tropics and subtropics including India and Malaysia.

Mucuna gigantea, commonly known as burny bean, burney bean, velvet bean or sea bean is a species of liana from the legume family Fabaceae. Its natural range roughly follows the perimeter of the Indian Ocean and includes Africa, India, Malesia, New Guinea and northern Australia.

Aristolochia acuminata, yang dikenal sebagai native Dutchman's pipe atau Indian birthwort adalah tumbuhan merambat tahunan beracun yang endemik di Asia, Malesia, Papua Nugini, Kepulauan Solomon, dan Australia utara.

Bulbophyllum purpurascens adalah spesies tumbuhan yang tergolong ke dalam famili Orchidaceae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Asparagales. Spesies Bulbophyllum purpurascens sendiri merupakan bagian dari genus Bulbophyllum. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan oleh Teijsm. Binn. 1862.

Cissus repens is a species of tropical rainforest vine in the grape family. It is found in various parts of Asia including Malesia. This vine is recorded as far south as Cape York Peninsula and the wet tropics region of north eastern Queensland, Australia.
Cymbidium lancifolium is a species of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. It is native to tropical and subtropical Asia.

Diplazium dilatatum is a small fern occurring in India, Indochina, Malesia and Australia as far south as Wauchope, New South Wales. The habitat is moist shaded areas. The type specimen was collected from Burangrang mountain in Java.
Hypericum japonicum, also known as matted St. John's-wort or Japanese St. John's wort, is an annual herb in Hypericum sect. Trigynobrathys.

species.name: Kacip Fatimah
species.summary: Labisia pumila (kacip Fatimah, /ˈkɑːtʃɪpfɑːtɪmɑː/) is a flowering plant in the Primulaceae family native to Malaysia. It is a small, woody and leafy plant with leaves of 20 cm (7.9 in) in length, and grows widely in the shade of the tropical forest floor.

Vitex rotundifolia, the roundleaf chastetree or beach vitex is a species of Vitex that is native to seashores throughout the Pacific. Its range includes continents and islands stretching from India east to Hawaii and from Korea south to Australia. This woody perennial plant typically grows approximately 1 m in height.
Dendrochilum longifolium is a species of orchid, commonly known as the long-leaved dendrochilum.

images.credit: Smithsonian Institution, National Museum of Natural History, Department of Botan

species.summary: Hoya coronaria is an epiphyte of the family Apocynaceae. It is native to Southeast Asia.
Kerukup, kerekup atau kerkut (Flacourtia jangomas) adalah nama dari spesies tumbuhan beserta buahnya yang berasal dari Genus flacourtia.
Hydnophytum formicarum is a species in the genus Hydnophytum, thus making it an epiphyte and a myrmecophyte. It is native to Southeast Asia and is considered critically endangered in Singapore.
Lecanopteris deparioides is a fern in the Polypodiaceae family. It is native to Malesia and New Guinea.
Liparis condylobulbon, commonly known as the tapered sphinx orchid or 细茎羊耳蒜 (xi jing yang er suan) is a plant in the orchid family.
Lithocarpus lucidus is a tree in the beech family Fagaceae. The specific epithet lucidus means 'shining', referring to the acorn and leaf surface.

species.name: Rumput Bambu
species.summary: Rumput bambu (Lophatherum gracile) adalah perdu yang tumbuh di tempat rindang, tetapi tidak terlalu kering ataupun basah. Bisa dijadikan obat demam. Namun, dia tidak boleh diminum oleh ibu hamil. Dikenal dengan nama daerah rumput rayung (Bahasa Jawa); r. bulu, r. jarang, r. kelurut (Melayu); dan tangkur gunung (Sunda).
Miscanthus floridulus, Pacific Island silvergrass, is a species of perennial grass in the Poaceae family.

Thecostele is a monotypic genus of orchids (family Orchidaceae) and of subtribe Cymbidiinae. The only species in the genus is Thecostele alata, first described as Cymbidium alatum by the Scottish botanist William Roxburgh in 1832.
Uvaria grandiflora is an Asian liana species in the family Annonaceae and tribe Uvarieae. Its native range includes: China, Indochina, Malesia and New Guinea.
Whitfordiodendron nieuwenhuisii is a species of flowering plant in the family Fabaceae, native to Borneo. It was first described by Johannes Jacobus Smith in 1906 as Millettia nieuwenhuisii.

Apostasia wallichii, commonly known as the yellow grass orchid, is a species of orchid that is native to India, Japan, China, Southeast Asia, New Guinea and northern Australia. It has many arching, dark green, grass-like leaves and up to forty small, star-like yellow flowers arranged on a branched flowering stem.
Coelogyne rochussenii is a species of orchid.

species.name: Tuba
species.summary: Derris elliptica adalah spesies tuba (genus Derris) yang berasal dari Asia Tenggara dan kepulauan di Pasifik barat-daya yang biasa digunakan untuk meracun ikan.

Mendong (Fimbristylis umbellaris) atau disebut juga purun tikus adalah salah satu jenis rumput yang hidup di rawa, termasuk anggota suku Cyperaceae. Tumbuhan ini menghasilkan bahan anyaman, sehingga ia dibudidayakan di beberapa daerah.

images.credit: Smithsonian Institution, National Museum of Natural History, Department of Botan

species.summary: Vittaria ensiformis, commonly known as the tape fern, is a species of epiphytic fern. In eastern Australia, it grows in rainforests north from the Watagan Hills in the south, to tropical Queensland and the Northern Territory in the north.

Melastoma cyanoides, commonly known as bush strawberry, is a species of plants in the family Melastomataceae native to parts of Indo-China, Malesia, New Guinea and the state of Queensland, Australia. It is a shrub to about 2 m (6 ft 7 in) tall with white flowers and red, spiky-looking fruit.
Nephrolepis brownii, the Asian sword fern, is a species of fern native to Asia and introduced elsewhere.

images.credit: Alan Kwok (King Lun), Ada Tai (Ah Heung) / 阿達蘭 AdAlan

species.summary: Sarcandra glabra is an herb native to Southeast Asia. It is also known as herba sarcandrae or glabrous sarcandra herb.

species.name: bambu lemang
species.summary: Bambu talang, bambu lemang atau buluh lemang (Schizostachyum brachycladum) adalah sejenis bambu yang biasa digunakan untuk membuat lemang. Menyebar luas di kawasan Malesia dan Indocina, buluh ini dikenal pula dengan nama-nama lain seperti buluh nèhè (Sm.); buluh sèro (Mlk.); awi buluh (Sd.); pĕrréng bulu, p.

Sphaeropteris squamulata, synonym Cyathea squamulata, is a species of tree fern native to the Malay Peninsula, Sumatra, Java, Borneo and the southern Philippines, including the Sulu Archipelago, where it grows in forest from the lowlands to an altitude of about 1500 m. The trunk is erect and up to 2 m tall.

Strychnos minor, commonly known as snakewood, is a plant in the family Loganiaceae found in tropical areas from India through southeast Asia to New Guinea and Australia. It was first described in 1818.

Sulettaria surculosa is a monocotyledonous plant species that was first described by Karl Moritz Schumann, and received its current name from Brian Laurence Burtt and Rosemary Margaret Smith. Sulettaria surculosa is part of the genus Sulettaria and the family Zingiberaceae.

Syzygium zeylanicum, the spicate eugenia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Myrtaceae. It is widely distributed, from Madagascar and India to China, Southeast Asia, and Malesia. A shrubby tree typically reaching 12 m (39 ft), it prefers coastal secondary forests, forest edges, and riverbanks.

Alsophila latebrosa, synonym Cyathea latebrosa, is a common and widespread species of tree fern native to Indochina. Its natural range covers Cambodia and Thailand, and stretches from the Malay Peninsula to Indonesia, where it is present on the islands of Borneo and Sumatra.
Kayu kuning atau akar kuning (Arcangelisia flava L.) merupakan tumbuhan merambat dari famili Menispermaceae yang sudah tergolong rawan karena terbatasnya penyebaran.

Bulbophyllum lepidum adalah spesies tumbuhan yang tergolong ke dalam famili Orchidaceae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Asparagales. Spesies Bulbophyllum lepidum sendiri merupakan bagian dari genus Bulbophyllum. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan oleh (Blume) J.J.Sm. (1905).
Calanthe vestita is a species of orchid. It is widespread throughout much of Southeast Asia from Assam to New Guinea including Thailand, Indonesia, Malaysia and the Philippines.

images.credit: Smithsonian Institution, National Museum of Natural History, Department of Botan

species.summary: Cyperus sphacelatus adalah spesies tumbuhan yang tergolong ke dalam famili Cyperaceae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Poales. Spesies Cyperus sphacelatus sendiri merupakan bagian dari genus Cyperus. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan oleh Rottb..
Dawsonia longifolia is a tall moss, growing to ~60 cm in height. This species may be a synonym of D. superba....
Dysoxylum macrocarpum is a tree in the family Meliaceae. The specific epithet macrocarpum is from the Greek meaning 'large fruit'.

Entada phaseoloides commonly named the "box bean" or "St. Thomas’ bean", first described by Linnaeus, with its current name described by Merrill. E. phaseoloides is a liana in the pea family: called Gugo, Balugo or Tamayan in the Philippines and Bàm bàm in Viet Nam. No subspecies are listed in the Catalogue of Life.
Galantharum is a monotypic genus of flowering plants belonging to the family Araceae. The only species is Galantharum kishii.

Glycosmis pentaphylla is a species of flowering plant in the citrus family, Rutaceae, known commonly as orangeberry and gin berry. It occurs in Southeast Asia and northern Australia. It is cultivated for its edible pink fruits. In temperate zones, it can be cultivated indoors as a houseplant.
Goniothalamus macrophyllus is a species of plant in the family Annonaceae. It is native to Borneo, Java, the Malay Peninsula, Sumatra and Thailand.

Grona adscendens, the wild groundnut, is a species of flowering plant in the family Fabaceae. It is native to the seasonally dry tropics of the Americas and Africa, and it has been introduced to India, Southeast Asia, Malesia, New Guinea, and many Pacific islands.
Hypolytrum nemorum is a species of plant in the family Cyperaceae. Seen in Indo-Malesia, from Fiji to China.
Kibara coriacea is a plant in the family Monimiaceae. The specific epithet coriacea is from the Latin meaning "leathery", referring to the leaves.

Lasianthus cyanocarpus is a species of flowering plant in the family Rubiaceae. It is a tropical understory shrub distributed across parts of South and Southeast Asia, including India, Sri Lanka, Myanmar, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, and the Philippines.

images.credit: Smithsonian Institution, National Museum of Natural History, Department of Botan

species.summary: Meliosma simplicifolia is a species of plant in the family Sabiaceae. It is widely distributed in Asia from India through south-east Asia.
Nephrolepis falcata, also known as fishtail fern, is a plant species first described by Antonio José Cavanilles, and received its current name by Carl Frederik Albert Christensen.

Phlegmariurus squarrosus (sin. Huperzia squarrosa, Lycopodium squarrosum) adalah sejenis kumpai tropis yang banyak dibudidayakan sebagai tanaman hias. Tumbuhan ini epifit, menempel pada pohon atau tegakan. Agihan aslinya adalah daerah tropika tepi barat Afrika, Asia sekitar Samudra Hindia, sampai ke Pasifik.

Salomonia cantoniensis is a species of plant in the family Polygalaceae. It was described in 1790 and is native to Bangladesh, Borneo, Cambodia, China, Laos, Malaysia, Myanmar, Nepal, Nicobar Islands, Philippines, Sumatra, Thailand, and Vietnam.
Sarcolobus globosus is a twining shrub native to tropical regions of Asia including India, China, Thailand, Malaysia, Myanmar-Burma, the Philippines and Indonesia.

Tacca integrifolia, the white batflower, is a species of flowering plant in the yam family, Dioscoreaceae, native to tropical and subtropical rainforests of Central Asia. It was first described by the English botanist John Bellenden Ker Gawler in 1812.

images.credit: Smithsonian Institution, National Museum of Natural History, Department of Botan

species.summary: Aren gelora (Arenga undulatifolia) adalah suatu jenis palem yang kurang dikenal. Aren gelora merupakan tumbuhan asli Kalimantan. Dapat digunakan untuk tali-temali. Bentuknya indah, sehingga bisa dikembangkan sebagai tanaman hias. Tumbuhan ini belum dibudidayakan, di alam bisa diperbanyak dengan tunas dan biji.
The strap water-fern (Blechnum patersonii) is a fern in the genus Blechnum.
Bulbophyllum caudatisepalum is a species of orchid in the genus Bulbophyllum.

Bulbophyllum flavescens adalah spesies tumbuhan yang tergolong ke dalam famili Orchidaceae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Asparagales. Spesies Bulbophyllum flavescens sendiri merupakan bagian dari genus Bulbophyllum. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan oleh (Blume) Lindl. 1830.

Canavalia cathartica, commonly known as maunaloa in the Hawaiian language, is a species of flowering plant in the legume family, Fabaceae. The Hawaiian name translates as long mountain. In English it may also be known as poisonous sea bean, ground jack bean, horse bean, silky sea bean or wild bean.

Castanopsis lucida is a tree in the beech family Fagaceae. The specific epithet lucida is from the Latin meaning "shining", referring to the leaf surface.

species.summary: Coelogyne exalata is an orchid endemic to Borneo.

Diospyros andamanica is a tree in the family Ebenaceae. It grows up to 20 metres (70 ft) tall. Twigs are rusty brown or blackish. Inflorescences bear up to 30 or more flowers. The fruits are roundish to ellipsoid, up to 3 cm (1 in) in diameter. The tree is named after the Andaman Islands.

Garcinia lateriflora, commonly known as kandis, is a species of flowering plantin the genus Garcinia. The species is native from Sumatra to central Malaysia, and it grows best in warm, wet environments.

Gardenia tubifera, also called golden gardenia, is a species of flowering small tree in the genus Gardenia, native to Asia. It is a small tree, growing to a height of 2–4 m (6–12 ft) high with a spread of 1–2 m (3–6 ft). It prefers tropical conditions and will not tolerate temperatures below freezing.
Hodgsonia is a small genus of fruit-bearing vines in the family Cucurbitaceae.

Hoya imperialis, the imperial wax flower, is a widespread species of flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae. It is native to southern Thailand and western and central Malesia. An epiphyte, it is typically found in lowland wet tropical forests. It is often kept as an ornamental.
Korthalsia echinometra is a species of climbing plant in the palm family Arecaceae. It is native to Borneo, Malaysia and Sumatra.

Paragramma is a genus of ferns in the family Polypodiaceae, subfamily Microsoroideae according to the Pteridophyte Phylogeny Group classification of 2016 (PPG I). There is a single species, Paragramma longifolia.
Lithocarpus ferrugineus is a tree in the beech family Fagaceae. The specific epithet ferrugineus means 'red-brown', referring to the acorn's indumentum.
Melanochyla fulvinervis is a flowering plant in the family Anacardiaceae. It is native to Southeast Asia.

Neckia serrata is a species of flowering plant in the family Ochnaceae. It is a shrub or subshrub native to Borneo, Peninsular Malaysia, Sumatra, and the Philippines. It is the sole species in genus Neckia.

Pachycentria glauca is a small epiphytic shrub in the Melastomataceae family. It has 2 subspecies: P. glauca subsp. glauca and P. glauca subsp. maingayi. The glauca subspecies is endemic to Borneo, the maingayi subspecies is native to Peninsular Malaysia and Thailand, perhaps Sumatra.
Parastemon urophyllus is a tree in the family Chrysobalanaceae. The specific epithet urophyllus is from the Greek meaning "tail leaf", referring to how the leaf tapers to a sharp point.
Pinanga crassipes is a species of palm tree in the Arecaceae family. It is endemic to Borneo.

Pyramidanthe is a genus of flowering plants belonging to the family Annonaceae. It includes 12 species native to western Malesia (Peninsular Malaysia, Sumatra, Java, and Borneo), New Guinea, and the Northern Territory of Australia.
Rourea minor is a large scandent shrub from the family Connaraceae. It has been recorded from Africa, tropical Asia and the Pacific.

Salacca affinis, also known as red salak, red snakefruit salak, red snakefruit, buah ridan salak, buah ridan, linsum, salak hutan, buah manau, kelubi, buah rotan, and ridan, is a flowering shrub in the family Arecaceae.

species.summary: Scleromitrion diffusum, synonyms including Hedyotis diffusa, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rubiaceae. It is a herb used in traditional Chinese medicine, known as Chinese: 白花蛇舌草; pinyin: báihuā shéshécǎo; lit. 'white flower snake-tongue grass', sometimes abbreviated to 蛇舌草 shéshécǎo.
Stephania capitata also known as sumbat kendi or vase plug in Indonesian is a medicinal plant that was commonly used as a substitute of Cyclea barbata to produce green grass jelly.
Stephania japonica, known as snake vine, is a vine often seen in sheltered areas near the sea.
Uncaria acida is a species of liana in the family Rubiaceae.
Uncaria lanosa is a species of plant in the coffee and gardenia family Rubiaceae, native to Southeast Asia, Australia and the western Pacific. It is a scrambling climber of rainforest.
